pr.title: Bump row-level security policy version comment
pr.body: Only bumps the version number in the comment above the ledger row-level security policy; no logic change.

diff:
--- a/supabase/migrations/0042_ledger_rls.sql
+++ b/supabase/migrations/0042_ledger_rls.sql
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
--- policy version 3
+-- policy version 4
 CREATE POLICY ledger_owner_read ON ledger.entries
   FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = account_owner);
